data.narrative:
Nimble Robotics is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by Simon Kalouche, currently valued at $1.0B post-money with $221M raised to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 9 private peers (Hadrian, Agile Robots, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics among them) and 1 public company in the robotics and manufacturing sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $1.0B last post-money valuation and applying a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, yields $1.7B. Peer-median analysis across 6 same-sector and adjacent-stage comparables—including Exotec at $2.0B (Series D), Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B (Series B), Hadrian at $1.6B (Series C), and Dexterity at $1.6B (Series B)—produces a median of $1.7B with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B. Both methods converge on identical implied values.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $1.7B. Key uncertainties include the timing and terms of the next financing event, competitive positioning relative to higher-valued Series B peers, and execution risk on revenue milestones typical of Stage C robotics companies.
